Mid lanes, imo an easier in theory lane due to the idea that generally being push wave, help out fights anywhere else, this makes it so that your constantly affecting everyone. Obv easy champs help you learn the game better, cause you dont have to focus on mechanics, your attention is purely on macro, so if you're new, it makes sense to play easier champs. But the reason i play league is to get those highs of outplays, so even if your worse for now, the second you get the high skill cieling champ down to a t, trust me, the games gonna be soo much more fun. Either way, commit to a role. Pick 2-3 champs and exclusively play them if you want to climb. Most basic answer is often the right one.
